newsitem.title: USA: Three arrested in St. Patrick's Day attack.
newsitem.headline: Three arrested in St. Patrick's Day attack.

text.p: Three young men were arrested on Tuesday in connection with a brutal St. Patrick's Day beating that left a teenager in extremely critical condition with massive head injuries.

The victim, 18-year-old Michael Sarti, was kicked and punched during a drunken brawl about a block from the route of Monday's huge St. Patrick's Day parade, police said. At least 30 people were involved in the mid-afternoon fight at the posh intersection of 59th Street and Madison Avenue on Manhattan's Upper East Side, police said.

The violence broke out among a crowd of parade-goers, many of whom appeared to have been drinking heavily, witnesses and police said. Sarti was comatose and in extremely critical condition at a local hospital.
Police arrested Jason Andrade, 18, of Brooklyn and said he was suspected of kicking Sarti repeatedly. Witnesses picked Andrade out of a police line-up.

Also arrested were Michael Papayiannis, 20, and Billy Syversten, 20. All three were charged with rioting and unlawful assembly and Andrade was also charged with assault, police said. All three live in Bay Ridge, a middle- and working-class neighbourhood in Brooklyn.
Sarti lives in the Bronx, another of the city's five boroughs, north of Manhattan.
A 16-year-old boy suffered cuts to the scalp in the melee, authorities said.
